# Kautusang Bayan No. 01, Series of 1999

**Additional Appropriations Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance approves and allocates the amount of P257,077.13 for additional primary needs and other expenses of the local government of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. It is enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] during its session.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Allocates P257,077.13 from the Unappropriated Balance or Remaining Unallocated Expenses of the Annual Budget 1999 and additional IRA for the year 1999 for the primary needs and expenses of the local government of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
2.  **Section 2.** The Additional Appropriation No. 01, Series of 1999, prepared by the Honorable [[Punong Bayan]], is included and made an additional part of this ordinance, marked as "Annex A".
3.  **Section 3.** The "Kautusang Bayan" for Additional Appropriations shall take effect upon approval.
4.  **Section 4.** Approved on [[1999-07-06]] in [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
